rounds.text: Happy Steels Ltd presents a concerning disconnect between its reported accounting profits and actual cash generation. While the company reports profit growth, it fails to translate this into shareholder returns, evidenced by a 0.00% dividend yield [E4] and the explicit negative flag that it is not paying out dividends despite repeated profits [E42]. The financial health is further strained by a negative free cash flow of Rs -4.99 Cr [E28] and an increase in total borrowings to Rs 53.47 Cr [E30]. Long-term sales growth remains stagnant, with a compounded sales growth of only 4% over five years [E14] and 0% over the last three years [E15], suggesting the business struggles to scale its top line. Furthermore, the company’s historical performance is mediocre, with a 5-year median return on equity of only 9% [E20] and a negative flag regarding the potential capitalization of interest costs [E45]. Conceded: [E19], [E35], [E36].
